output.scope_note: The paper reports a room-temperature-range ionic conductivity (3.0 mS cm-1 at 303 K) for a Li-salt-doped ionic liquid ionanofluid electrolyte, which is a solid-state-relevant Li-ion conductor study within the extraction scope.

records.notes: Ionanofluid electrolyte (5.0 wt% TiO2-NHIF dispersed in 0.6 M Li salt in Pyr14TFSI, a liquid electrolyte rather than a sintered solid). Value is the maximum conductivity; the paper calls it 'ionic conductivity' from the real part of the spectrum. Temperature 303 K converted to 30 C. LiBr is an intentional salt component (dopant salt); the TiO2 filler is not listed as a dopant. Activation energies are only in Table 1 with garbled layout, so left null. Other conductivities are not given as numbers in the text.
